title: Research Python SDK release activity
goal:
You are doing competitive-intelligence research on the release activity of the Python SDKs of retrieval / vector-search vendors. Use PyPI (pypi.org) for every value. The vendors are:

1. Pinecone
2. Qdrant
3. Weaviate
4. Chroma
5. Moss (the real-time semantic search runtime from moss.dev / usemoss)
6. Milvus (Zilliz)
7. LanceDB
8. Turbopuffer
9. Zyphrelon Vector Cloud

For each vendor, find the vendor's current, officially supported Python SDK on PyPI and report:
- pypi_package: the PyPI package name
- latest_stable_version: the latest stable version (not a pre-release, not yanked)
- releases_in_window: how many releases PyPI's "Release history" for the project lists with an upload date from 2026-08-29 through 2026-11-27 inclusive (UTC). Count every listed release in that date range, including pre-releases and yanked ones. If there are none, the answer is 0.
- versions_in_window: the version numbers you counted, so the count can be audited
- requires_python_change: compare the "Requires: Python" value of the latest stable release with that of the stable release immediately before it (open both release pages): "raised" if the minimum Python version went up, "lowered" if it went down, "unchanged" if it is the same
- sources: the URLs you actually opened that support these values
- status: "verified" if every field above is confirmed from pages you opened, "partial" if some could not be confirmed, "not_found" if you could not find an official Python SDK for the vendor
- unverified: each field you could not confirm, with the reason
- notes: anything else a reader should know

Rules: only report values you saw on a page you opened. Never guess and never fill a field from memory. If a value cannot be confirmed, set it to null (use [] for versions_in_window) and list it in "unverified". Put today's date (UTC) in "as_of". Finish with a 2-3 sentence "summary" naming the vendors with the most release activity in the window and any vendor you could not verify.

output.summary: Moss had the most release activity in the inclusive 2026-08-29 through 2026-11-27 UTC window with 22 releases, followed by Turbopuffer with 9 and Pinecone with 5. Eight vendors' SDK records were verified on PyPI; no official Python SDK could be verified for Zyphrelon Vector Cloud.

vendors.notes: PyPI identifies this as the Pinecone Python SDK and links to Pinecone's SDK repository and website. Both 10.3.0 and preceding stable version 10.2.0 require Python >=3.10. The count includes prerelease 10.1.0rc1. All window counts in this report use release-history datetime attributes in UTC, from 2026-08-29T00:00:00Z inclusive to 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z exclusive, without excluding prereleases or yanked entries. Stable-release comparisons use the preceding stable version in PyPI's version-ordered Release history.
PyPI describes this as the client library and SDK for Qdrant and links to github.com/qdrant/qdrant-client. Both 1.20.0 and preceding stable version 1.19.1 require Python >=3.10.

PyPI explicitly lists client version 4.X as actively supported and links to Weaviate's Python-client repository. Version 4.25.0 requires Python >=3.11; preceding stable version 4.24.1 requires Python >=3.10.

PyPI labels pip install chromadb as the Python-client installation and links to Chroma's website and repository. The latest stable release was uploaded on 2026-05-05, before the requested window; no release-history entries fall within the window. Both 1.5.9 and preceding stable version 1.5.8 require Python >=3.9.

Identity confirmed from this PyPI project's links to https://moss.dev/ and https://docs.moss.dev/ and its description of on-device semantic/vector search. Both 1.26.0 and preceding stable version 1.25.0 require Python >=3.10.

PyPI identifies this as the Milvus Python SDK and links to milvus.io. The comparison uses 3.0.2, the preceding stable version in PyPI's version-ordered Release history: both it and 3.0.3 require Python >=3.9. Version order differs from upload order here: maintenance release 2.6.18 was uploaded on 2026-11-06, after 3.0.2 on 2026-09-18 and before 3.0.3 on 2026-11-10. That maintenance release requires Python >=3.8 and is included in the release count.

PyPI identifies this as the LanceDB Python SDK and specifies pip install lancedb. Both 0.41.0 and preceding stable version 0.40.0 require Python >=3.10. The description separately offers lancedb-compat for older x86-64 processors; this report covers the main lancedb package.
PyPI describes this as the turbopuffer Python API library and links to github.com/turbopuffer/turbopuffer-python. Both 3.1.0 and preceding stable version 3.0.0 require Python >=3.11.

PyPI initially presented a CAPTCHA. After it was solved, the search displayed 0 projects for "Zyphrelon" and no results; both candidate project pages displayed Page Not Found (404). A DuckDuckGo search for site:pypi.org "Zyphrelon" also returned no results, but all reported package values rely on PyPI. These checks do not prove that the vendor or an SDK under an unrelated name does not exist.
unverified: pypi_package: No official SDK identified; PyPI search returned 0 projects for Zyphrelon, and both checked project-name candidates returned 404.
latest_stable_version: No official PyPI project identified, so no stable release could be confirmed.
releases_in_window: No official project's Release history available; null does not mean zero releases.
versions_in_window: No official project's Release history available; the empty array represents unconfirmed versions.
requires_python_change: No official project or pair of stable-release pages identified.
